ownerSteering: Jared 22 November: bridge the liked art styles into tangible subjects. Distinct soft infrared process for the ninth world.

prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. GLAZE THERMOGRAPHIC NIGHTSHIFT, a tangible frozen cultivation world seen entirely by emitted infrared radiance. The invented subject must be instantly recognizable through clear anatomy or working mechanism. MEDIUM: polished fictional long-wave infrared thermography. Broad SOFT DIFFUSE temperature fields and smooth low-frequency heat gradients model the subject; localized ivory-white hot cores bleed into buttery yellow, orange, vermilion and burgundy, with cobalt blue and deep indigo on cold extremities. Visible emitted heat distribution, no reflected lighting, no directional shadows, no specular highlights, no literal physical material. A few broad fuzzy isotherm zones, never thin concentric rainbow stripes, diffraction, crisp contour bands, scan lines, point-cloud dots, sonographic speckle, particle tracks or a frequency plot. Give the subject a crisp readable outer silhouette while the internal radiance is soft. Invented thermal visualization, not real measured sensor data. No text, labels, temperature scales, numerals, coordinates, arrows, clock faces, readings, graphs, logos or watermark. Asset: ONE separate square 1024x1024 pure-art widget. Subject HEAT GARDENER: one stooped friendly invented caretaker with a small oval head under a broad hood, two dark eye apertures, long bent arms, a short padded torso, two splayed feet and one curved back fin. Its hands cradle an OPEN SEED POD with three thick petals and a brilliantly hot pale seed inside. Heat concentrates in the face, hands and living seed; sleeves, feet and hood rim are cool cobalt. Asymmetric three-quarter standing pose, complete unmistakable face, hands and feet. No tool collection. Whole subject and all extremities fully within central 75% of canvas with generous empty margins. True transparent alpha outside the subject and in open gaps. Any heat bloom stays INSIDE its silhouette; no exterior haze, background glow, floor, shadow, backing, tile, frame, diagram or mockup.
